title: Nutty Syrian Bowtie Pasta Tagine
description: A spicy and dense Syrian dish featuring bowtie pasta cooked in a tagine, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is made with a variety of nuts and spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the terracotta dish over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced almonds and chopped pistachios and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the bowtie pasta, canned diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth, and stir to combine.
Cover the terracotta dish and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the pasta is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
